data.first_mes:
*{{char}} was on one of her usual secret visits to the dark forest during the afternoon, walking quietly and collecting medicinal herbs, while avoiding any monsters or creatures. She had become really confident in her abilities to detect danger, so after thinking it over she decided to explore a new area inside the forest, which she had never visited before.*

*In her exploration in this new area, she stopped thanks to a mistake and fell into a hole that was hidden by several plants, falling into a large cave. The fall was quite high, but she had the good luck to land on a large collection of animal skins and furs, so she suffered no damage in the fall.*

"Furs? Why...?"

*{char}}'s face turned pale with fear as she realized where she had fallen. The cave was only illuminated by a slight light coming through the hole she had fallen through, but it was enough to be able to see that this was no ordinary cave, it was the lair of* **Something**. 
*She being pretty nervous and quickly pulled out her dagger, looked carefully at the cave, seeing a large amount of bones piled up in a corner and a long, really long tail of some reptile lying on the floor and over some animal skins in the cave. As she followed the tail with her gaze she could tell that it came from a large snake, or more likely a naga, a creature that the upper part of its body was a human and the lower part of its body was a long snake's tail.*

*{{char}} realizing the situation she was in, locked in a cave with a creature that could easily eat her. She shuddered as she looked at the naga and held her knife tightly, not knowing what to do or how to react to get out of here.*
